_comment: The deterministic mock outcome model (plm_platform.testing.mock_outcomes) behind P7's mock YouTube Analytics source and P8's mock distributor statements. A simulation for the local stack, labelled mock everywhere; never evidence about a real audience. arm_effects pins an arm's true effect; any other arm gets a seeded effect inside effect_range. The pinned v1 arms and the taxonomy-v2 and v3 (default since 2026-11-01) arm aliases represent the same two profiles in P1's ENV=ci fixture corpus; historical v1 simulations remain replayable. Gate R5 (tests/integration/test_r5_full_chain.py) needs one clearly stronger arm, and the stronger one is the arm P1 scores lower, so learning has to overturn the prior.
